cc:Work.dc:title: 1.9 TW of power plants wait in U.S. interconnection queues, mostly solar and storage
cc:Work.dc:description: Nine stacked bar charts of active interconnection requests by entry year; 1.9 TW in total, mostly solar, hybrid and storage.
